specMarkdown:
# Swiss-Bauhaus Pixel Poster — Visual Specification

## Visual Grammar
- **Geometry**: Strict `0px` corners and crisp `1px` architectural rules (`#0A0A0A` in Light, `#2E313D` in Dark). Zero rounded pills, zero blurry drop shadows, zero decorative emoji clutter.
- **Surfaces**:
  - Light: Warm gallery paper (`#FAF9F5`) with `#FFFFFF` card panels and pitch ink (`#0A0A0A`).
  - Dark: Deep slate ink (`#101115`) with `#16181F` terminal surfaces and `#F4F4F6` foreground text.
- **Typography**:
  - Monumental 9-row geometric pixel display wordmark (`<path shape-rendering="crispEdges">`) for the developer handle and 4 bottom metric counters.
  - Display sans (`Inter Tight` / system sans fallback) for headlines & 2-line project copy.
  - Monospace (`JetBrains Mono` / Consolas fallback) for parenthetical tags `(projects)`, spec strips, and `$` terminal lines.
- **Orthogonal Pixel Weaves (`6x6` grid)**:
  - Hero right field: `plus` weave tinted to the developer's primary accent color (e.g. Hydro Blue `#7CC4FA` / `#4CA4EC` light, `#14243A` / `#1F3C63` dark).
  - 2x2 Project Cards (`417x194`, `width="49%"` in README): `cross` (Cobalt), `plus` (Sodium Orchid), `tartan` (Emerald x Cobalt), `basket` (Signal Amber).
- **Signature Portrait**:
  - Framed `28x28` graphic pixel portrait of the user's actual GitHub avatar inside a `142x142` frame with a `4px` hard-edge Bauhaus shadow.
  - Subtle `5.2s` step blink animation + `1.4s` terminal block cursor, both disabled under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
- **Project Cards**:
  - Top weave band (`54px` height) carrying a sharp black index badge `(01) Category` on the left and a custom `16x16` pixel emblem inside a `44x44` black square on the right.
  - Title (`20px` bold) + right-aligned link, crisp 2-line summary, bottom hairline divider, and mono spec strip (`Language · Stack · Stars · License`).

## Verification Requirements
1. Every generated `.svg` must pass strict XML parsing (`xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring`).
2. Render both Light and Dark previews at `846px` width and verify zero text clipping, balanced pill padding, and cursor alignment right after the terminal text.
3. Verify all external links return HTTP `200` before publishing.

specMarkdown:
# Architectural Blueprint CAD — Visual Specification

## Visual Grammar
- **Material & Atmosphere**: Authentic engineering blueprint drafting sheet.
  - **Dark**: Classic Prussian Blueprint Navy (`#0A1E38`) with crisp coordinate grid (`#112D52` minor / `#1B4070` major), drafting-white ink (`#EAF4FF`), and cyan dimension accents (`#38BDF8`).
  - **Light**: Architectural Vellum Tracing Paper (`#F4F7FB`) with soft drafting-blue grid (`#E3ECF6` minor / `#C9DAEE` major), deep blueprint ink (`#0E2A4D`), and engineering cobalt accents (`#1D5BB8`).
- **Drafting Structural Conventions**:
  - Outer sheet border + `8px` inset inner border with corner registration crosshairs (`⊕`) and engineering zone labels (`A / B / C / D`).
  - Chamfered 45° corner tags (`polygon`) for buttons and project drawing numbers (`DWG-01` .. `DWG-04`).
  - Dimension arrows (`|<--- ... --->|`) and dashed construction lines (`stroke-dasharray="3 3"`).
- **Hero Drafting Sheet (`846x300`)**:
  - Top revision strip: `DWG NO.`, `REV`, `SCALE 1:1`, `STATUS`.
  - Left elevation: uppercase display handle with crisp offset shadow & dimension line, role/stack specs, and chamfered `NOTE 01` callout box.
  - Right target reticle (`x=584..826`): calibrated azimuth rings (`0°/90°/180°/270°`), centered isometric cube schematic, and a calm `16s` orbital sweep arc (`prefers-reduced-motion` safe).
  - Bottom 4-cell CAD Title Block (`DRAWN BY`, `FLAGSHIPS`, `PUBLIC REPOS`, `ECOSYSTEM`).
- **2x2 Project Blueprint Sheets (`417x198`)**:
  - Each card includes a top-left chamfered drawing tag (`DWG-01`), title, concise 2-line engineering summary (strictly kept left of `x=312`), a framed `76x64` custom wireframe schematic diagram on the right, and a bottom BOM spec line.

## Verification Requirements
1. Strict XML validation on every generated SVG.
2. Verify Light (vellum) and Dark (blueprint) contrast >= 4.5:1 on all labels and verify zero overlap between 2-line card copy and the right-hand schematic box.

# Editorial Broadsheet Zine — Visual Specification

## Visual Grammar
- **Material & Tone**: Timeless independent print monograph & Swiss broadsheet typography. Zero neon glows, zero clutter, maximum typographic poise.
  - **Light**: Archival warm paper (`#F7F3EA`), editorial ink (`#141311`), muted sepia stone (`#6E685E`), vermilion stamp accent (`#C93B2B`).
  - **Dark**: Warm obsidian press (`#131210`), bone ivory (`#F0EBE1`), warm charcoal rules (`#33302B`), luminous vermilion (`#E45847`).
- **Typographic Voice**:
  - Monumental serif display (`Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif`) for the nameplate, italic deck, section titles, and plate headings.
  - Tracked uppercase monospace (`JetBrains Mono`) for volume/issue metadata, plate labels (`PLATE I`..`PLATE IV`), and technical colophon footnotes.
- **Broadsheet Hero (`846x302`)**:
  - Classic double-rule newspaper header (`2px` heavy bar + `3px` gap + `0.8px` hairline) framing `VOL. IV · NO. 12`, `OPEN-SOURCE MONOGRAPH`, and `EDITION 2026`.
  - Left editorial column (`x=28..530`): large serif nameplate with vermilion square full stop, italic deck description, and subtle horizontal pull-quote divider.
  - Right colophon ledger (`x=564..818`): structured 6-row editorial metadata table separated by crisp hairlines.
- **2x2 Magazine Feature Plates (`417x196`)**:
  - Top `3px` editorial ink rule (vermilion / cobalt / forest / ochre), Roman plate label, subtle line-art colophon mark, bold serif title, generous two-line prose, and hairline technical colophon strip.

## Verification Requirements
1. Strict XML validation on all SVGs.
2. Check Light & Dark contrast, serif legibility, and balanced ledger row alignment at `846px` width.

# Retro CRT Terminal TUI — Visual Specification

## Visual Grammar
- **Surfaces & Palette**:
  - **Dark**: Deep Phosphor Terminal (`#0A0F12`), chrome bar (`#11181D`), crisp borders (`#22303A`), subtle `4px` horizontal scanline overlay (`opacity=0.04`, zero flashing), Emerald (`#34D399`), Cyan (`#38BDF8`), Amber (`#FBBF24`), Magenta (`#F472B6`).
  - **Light**: Crisp Solarized Paper Terminal (`#F7F5EE`), chrome bar (`#EAE6DA`), borders (`#C8C2B2`), Pine Emerald (`#0E7C5B`), Cobalt (`#1D5FD6`), Rust Amber (`#B45309`), Plum (`#A21CAF`).
- **Hero (`846x306`)**:
  - Top TTY window header bar (`h=28`) with 3 traffic lights, shell path (`<user>@github: ~/profile — zsh`), and `tmux 3.4` tag.
  - Left pane (`x=14..286`): pixel-crisp vector monogram sigil (avoids cross-OS monospace ASCII glyph drift) + `$ whoami` readout with calm `1.4s` blinking block cursor (`prefers-reduced-motion` safe).
  - Right pane (`x=304..832`): structured `neofetch` key-value profile table (`role`, `focus`, `stack`, `flagship`, `repos`, `web`) + classic 8-swatch ANSI terminal palette bar.
  - Bottom `tmux` status bar (`h=24`): `[NORMAL]` pill, numbered window tabs (`0:profile*`, `1..4`), and right-side encoding/status.
- **Action Buttons (`height="30"`)**: CLI command pills (`$ open ...`, `$ gh ...`).
- **2x2 tmux Project Panes (`417x194`)**: Numbered pane tabs (`[1] project.ext`), live status indicator, `> url` line, crisp 2-line terminal description, and bottom language/license spec strip.

## Verification Requirements
1. Strict XML parsing on every generated SVG.
2. Render Light & Dark previews at `846px` width and verify clean monospace column alignment, cursor placement, and zero text overlap across panes.
